Phase 1 (approx. 2,500 MVA) became operational at the Company's owned facility at Plot No. DTA-02-08, DTA Phase-II, Mahindra World City, Jaipur (the Directors' Report states this happened in October 2025; the Corporate Overview / Manufacturing Excellence sections state commissioning in September 2025).
